Ski Resort Market Analysis

Pairing snowy cities (\(\geq\) 100K pop, \(\geq\) 150mm peak month snow) with nearby ski resorts (\(\leq\) 150km). Goal: understand market structure, who owns what, which cities share resort access, concentration.

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import pandas as pd
import math, os
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime

plt.rcParams["figure.dpi"] = 200
plt.rcParams["font.size"] = 9
plt.rcParams["axes.spines.top"] = False
plt.rcParams["axes.spines.right"] = False
resorts = pd.read_csv('../../data/resorts/ski_resorts.csv')
cities = pd.read_json('../../data/cities/na_snowy_cities_100k.json', encoding='latin-1')
print(f'Resorts: {len(resorts)}  |  Snowy cities: {len(cities)}')

def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371
    d1, d2 = math.radians(lat2-lat1), math.radians(lon2-lon1)
    a = math.sin(d1/2)**2 + math.cos(math.radians(lat1))*math.cos(math.radians(lat2))*math.sin(d2/2)**2
    return R * 2 * math.atan2(math.sqrt(a), math.sqrt(1-a))

pairs = []
for _, resort in resorts.iterrows():
    if pd.isna(resort['lat']) or pd.isna(resort['lon']): continue
    for _, city in cities.iterrows():
        if resort['country'] != city['country']: continue
        dist = haversine(resort['lat'], resort['lon'], city['lat'], city['long'])
        if dist <= 150:
            pairs.append({
                'city': city['name'], 'city_state': city['state_province'],
                'city_pop': city['population'],
                'city_lat': city['lat'], 'city_lon': city['long'],
                'resort': resort['name'], 'resort_state': resort['state_province'],
                'owner': resort['owner'], 'slope_km': resort['slope_km'],
                'lifts': resort['lifts'], 'vertical_m': resort['vertical_m'],
                'resort_lat': resort['lat'], 'resort_lon': resort['lon'],
                'dist_km': round(dist, 1),
            })
pairs_df = pd.DataFrame(pairs)
print(f'Pairs: {len(pairs_df)} | Cities w/ resort: {pairs_df["city"].nunique()}/{len(cities)}')
Resorts: 148  |  Snowy cities: 106
Pairs: 622 | Cities w/ resort: 91/106
import folium
from folium import Circle, CircleMarker, PolyLine, TileLayer
from folium.plugins import GroupedLayerControl
import os, json as _json
from datetime import datetime

resort_cities = {}
for nm, g in pairs_df.groupby('resort'):
    resort_cities[nm] = g[['city','city_state','city_pop','dist_km']].sort_values('dist_km').to_dict('records')
city_resorts_lookup = {}
for nm, g in pairs_df.groupby('city'):
    city_resorts_lookup[nm] = g[['resort','owner','slope_km','lifts','dist_km']].sort_values('dist_km').to_dict('records')

city_owner = pairs_df.groupby(['city','owner'])['slope_km'].sum().reset_index()
city_total = pairs_df.groupby('city')['slope_km'].sum().reset_index().rename(columns={'slope_km':'total_km'})
city_owner = city_owner.merge(city_total, on='city')
city_owner['share'] = city_owner['slope_km'] / city_owner['total_km']
dom_owner = (city_owner.sort_values('share', ascending=False)
             .drop_duplicates('city').set_index('city')[['owner','share']].to_dict('index'))

matched_city_names = set(pairs_df['city'].unique())
unmatched = cities[~cities['name'].isin(matched_city_names)]
matched = cities[cities['name'].isin(matched_city_names)]
r_valid = resorts.dropna(subset=['lat','lon'])
all_owners = sorted(resorts['owner'].dropna().unique())
corporate_owners = [o for o in all_owners if o != 'Independent']

csv_path = '../../data/resorts/ski_resorts.csv'
try:
    ts = datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(csv_path)).strftime('%B %d, %Y')
except:
    ts = datetime.now().strftime('%B %d, %Y')
print(f'Matched: {len(matched)} | Unmatched: {len(unmatched)} | Resorts: {len(r_valid)}')
Matched: 93 | Unmatched: 13 | Resorts: 148
def _si(v):
    try: return str(int(v)) if v == v else '?'
    except: return '?'

def _rpop(r):
    s, v, li = _si(r['slope_km']), _si(r['vertical_m']), _si(r['lifts'])
    o = str(r['owner']) if pd.notna(r['owner']) else 'Independent'
    b = _si(r.get('base_m','')) + 'm' if r.get('base_m','') == r.get('base_m','') and pd.notna(r.get('base_m')) else '?'
    t = _si(r.get('summit_m','')) + 'm' if pd.notna(r.get('summit_m')) else '?'
    sv = resort_cities.get(r['name'], [])
    cr = ''
    for c in sv[:6]:
        cr += '<tr><td>' + c['city'] + '</td><td>' + c['city_state'] + '</td><td style="text-align:right">' + str(int(c['city_pop']/1e3)) + 'K</td><td style="text-align:right">' + str(int(c['dist_km'])) + '</td></tr>'
    if len(sv) > 6: cr += '<tr><td colspan=4 style="color:#999">+' + str(len(sv)-6) + ' more</td></tr>'
    h = '<div style="min-width:250px;font-size:11px">'
    h += '<b style="color:#dc2626">' + r['name'] + '</b><br>'
    h += '<span style="color:#888">' + str(r['state_province']) + ', ' + str(r['country']) + '</span><hr style="margin:3px 0">'
    h += '<b>Slope:</b> ' + s + ' km | <b>Vert:</b> ' + v + ' m<br>'
    h += '<b>Base:</b> ' + b + ' - <b>Summit:</b> ' + t + '<br>'
    h += '<b>Lifts:</b> ' + li + ' | <b>Owner:</b> ' + o + '<hr style="margin:3px 0">'
    h += '<b>Serves ' + str(len(sv)) + ' cities:</b><br>'
    h += '<table style="width:100%"><tr style="background:#fff0f0"><th>City</th><th>ST</th><th>Pop</th><th>km</th></tr>' + cr + '</table></div>'
    return h

def _cpop(c):
    ps = str(round(c['population']/1e6,1))+'M' if c['population']>1e6 else str(int(c['population']/1e3))+'K'
    cr = city_resorts_lookup.get(c['name'], [])
    dom = dom_owner.get(c['name'], {})
    dn, dp = dom.get('owner','N/A'), int(dom.get('share',0)*100)
    rr = ''
    for r in cr[:8]:
        rr += '<tr><td>' + str(r['resort']) + '</td><td>' + str(r['owner'])[:18] + '</td><td style="text-align:right">' + _si(r['slope_km']) + '</td><td style="text-align:right">' + str(int(r['dist_km'])) + '</td></tr>'
    if len(cr) > 8: rr += '<tr><td colspan=4 style="color:#999">+' + str(len(cr)-8) + ' more</td></tr>'
    h = '<div style="min-width:270px;font-size:11px">'
    h += '<b style="color:#1d4ed8">' + c['name'] + '</b> <span style="color:#888">(' + c['state_province'] + ')</span><br>'
    h += '<b>Pop:</b> ' + ps + ' | <b>Resorts:</b> ' + str(len(cr)) + '<br>'
    h += '<b>Top owner:</b> ' + dn + ' (' + str(dp) + '%)<hr style="margin:3px 0">'
    h += '<table style="width:100%"><tr style="background:#f0f4ff"><th>Resort</th><th>Owner</th><th>km</th><th>Dist</th></tr>' + rr + '</table></div>'
    return h

m = folium.Map(location=[47, -95], zoom_start=4, tiles=None)

# Base layers
t_terrain = TileLayer(tiles='https://{s}.tile.opentopomap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', attr='OpenTopoMap', name='Terrain', max_zoom=17)
t_clean = TileLayer(tiles='CartoDB positron', name='Clean')
t_sat = TileLayer(tiles='https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', attr='Esri', name='Satellite')
for t in [t_terrain, t_clean, t_sat]: t.add_to(m)

# Snow
snow_fgs = []
for ds, lab in [('2024-10-01','Oct'),('2024-11-01','Nov'),('2024-12-01','Dec'),('2025-01-01','Jan'),('2025-02-01','Feb'),('2025-03-01','Mar')]:
    fg = folium.FeatureGroup(name=lab, show=False)
    u6 = 'https://gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov/wmts/epsg3857/best/MODIS_Terra_NDSI_Snow_Cover/default/' + ds + '/GoogleMapsCompatible_Level6/{z}/{y}/{x}.png'
    u8 = 'https://gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov/wmts/epsg3857/best/MODIS_Terra_NDSI_Snow_Cover/default/' + ds + '/GoogleMapsCompatible_Level8/{z}/{y}/{x}.png'
    TileLayer(tiles=u6, attr='NASA', overlay=True, opacity=0.6, min_zoom=1, max_zoom=5).add_to(fg)
    TileLayer(tiles=u8, attr='NASA', overlay=True, opacity=0.6, min_zoom=5, max_zoom=12).add_to(fg)
    fg.add_to(m)
    snow_fgs.append(fg)

# Feature groups
fg_resorts = folium.FeatureGroup(name='All Resorts', show=True).add_to(m)
fg_indep = folium.FeatureGroup(name='Independent', show=False).add_to(m)
fg_chain = folium.FeatureGroup(name='Chain (all)', show=False).add_to(m)
owner_fgs = {}
for ow in corporate_owners:
    owner_fgs[ow] = folium.FeatureGroup(name=ow[:30], show=False)
    owner_fgs[ow].add_to(m)

# City groups by population (circles included)
fg_pop_small = folium.FeatureGroup(name='Pop <= 150K', show=True).add_to(m)
fg_pop_mid = folium.FeatureGroup(name='Pop 150K-300K', show=True).add_to(m)
fg_pop_large = folium.FeatureGroup(name='Pop 300K-1M', show=True).add_to(m)
fg_pop_mega = folium.FeatureGroup(name='Pop > 1M', show=True).add_to(m)


fg_no_resort = folium.FeatureGroup(name='No resort nearby', show=True).add_to(m)

def _pop_bucket(pop):
    if pop > 1_000_000: return fg_pop_mega
    if pop > 300_000: return fg_pop_large
    if pop > 150_000: return fg_pop_mid
    return fg_pop_small

# Unmatched cities
for _, c in unmatched.iterrows():
    ps = str(round(c['population']/1e6,1))+'M' if c['population']>1e6 else str(int(c['population']/1e3))+'K'
    CircleMarker([c['lat'],c['long']], radius=max(3,c['population']/200000), color='#94a3b8', fill=True, fill_color='#94a3b8', fill_opacity=0.5, tooltip=c['name']+' ('+ps+')').add_to(fg_no_resort)

# Matched cities: marker + 150km circle + 50km circle all in same pop group
for _, c in matched.iterrows():
    ps = str(round(c['population']/1e6,1))+'M' if c['population']>1e6 else str(int(c['population']/1e3))+'K'
    cr = city_resorts_lookup.get(c['name'], [])
    dom = dom_owner.get(c['name'], {})
    dn, dp = dom.get('owner','N/A'), int(dom.get('share',0)*100)
    rr = ''
    for r in cr[:8]:
        rr += '<tr><td>' + str(r['resort']) + '</td><td>' + str(r['owner'])[:18] + '</td><td style="text-align:right">' + _si(r['slope_km']) + '</td><td style="text-align:right">' + str(int(r['dist_km'])) + '</td></tr>'
    if len(cr) > 8: rr += '<tr><td colspan=4 style="color:#999">+' + str(len(cr)-8) + ' more</td></tr>'
    ph = '<div style="min-width:270px;font-size:11px">'
    ph += '<b style="color:#1d4ed8">' + c['name'] + '</b> <span style="color:#888">(' + c['state_province'] + ')</span><br>'
    ph += '<b>Pop:</b> ' + ps + ' | <b>Resorts:</b> ' + str(len(cr)) + '<br>'
    ph += '<b>Top owner:</b> ' + dn + ' (' + str(dp) + '%)<hr style="margin:3px 0">'
    ph += '<table style="width:100%"><tr style="background:#f0f4ff"><th>Resort</th><th>Owner</th><th>km</th><th>Dist</th></tr>' + rr + '</table></div>'
    fg = _pop_bucket(c['population'])
    Circle([c['lat'],c['long']], radius=150000, color='#3b82f6', weight=0.3, fill=True, fill_color='#bfdbfe', fill_opacity=0.05).add_to(fg)
    Circle([c['lat'],c['long']], radius=50000, color='#2563eb', weight=0.6, dash_array='4 4', fill=True, fill_color='#93c5fd', fill_opacity=0.08).add_to(fg)
    CircleMarker([c['lat'],c['long']], radius=max(3,c['population']/200000), color='#1d4ed8', fill=True, fill_color='#1d4ed8', fill_opacity=0.7, popup=folium.Popup(ph, max_width=320), tooltip=c['name']+' ('+ps+')').add_to(fg)

# Resorts (DivIcon triangles - same click behavior as CircleMarker)
def _add_r(r, fg):
    sz = max(12, int(float(r['slope_km'] if pd.notna(r['slope_km']) else 20) / 8))
    tip = r['name'] + ' (' + _si(r['slope_km']) + 'km)'
    tri = '<div style="color:#dc2626;font-size:' + str(sz) + 'px;line-height:1;text-shadow:0 0 3px white,0 0 3px white;">&#9650;</div>'
    icon = folium.DivIcon(html=tri, icon_size=(sz+4,sz+4), icon_anchor=((sz+4)//2,(sz+4)//2))
    folium.Marker(location=[r['lat'],r['lon']], icon=icon, popup=folium.Popup(_rpop(r), max_width=300), tooltip=tip).add_to(fg)

for _, r in r_valid.iterrows():
    ow = str(r['owner']) if pd.notna(r['owner']) else 'Independent'
    _add_r(r, fg_resorts)
    if ow == 'Independent':
        _add_r(r, fg_indep)
    else:
        _add_r(r, fg_chain)
        if ow in owner_fgs:
            _add_r(r, owner_fgs[ow])

# Grouped layer control
GroupedLayerControl(
    groups={
        'Snow Cover (zoom in for detail)': snow_fgs,
        'Resorts': [fg_resorts, fg_indep, fg_chain] + list(owner_fgs.values()),
        'Cities (Population)': [fg_pop_small, fg_pop_mid, fg_pop_large, fg_pop_mega, fg_no_resort],
    },
    exclusive_groups=False,
    collapsed=True,
).add_to(m)



# Search with compact dropdown
sd = {}
for _, r in r_valid.iterrows():
    sd[r['name']] = [round(r['lat'],4), round(r['lon'],4)]
for _, c in cities.iterrows():
    sd[c['name']] = [round(c['lat'],4), round(c['long'],4)]
map_name = m.get_name()

shtml = ''
# Container
shtml += '<div id="srch-wrap" style="position:fixed;top:12px;left:55px;z-index:9999;width:230px;font-family:sans-serif;">'
shtml += '<input id="srch-in" type="text" placeholder="Search..."'
shtml += ' style="width:100%;padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;background:white;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);box-sizing:border-box;"'
shtml += ' autocomplete="off">'
shtml += '<div id="srch-dd" style="display:none;max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;background:white;border:1px solid #ddd;border-top:none;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);"></div>'
shtml += '</div>'

# JS
shtml += '<script>'
shtml += 'var _locs=' + _json.dumps(sd) + ';'
shtml += 'var _names=Object.keys(_locs).sort();'
shtml += 'var _in=document.getElementById("srch-in"),_dd=document.getElementById("srch-dd");'
# On input: filter and show dropdown
shtml += '_in.addEventListener("input",function(){'
shtml += 'var q=_in.value.trim().toLowerCase();'
shtml += 'if(q.length<2){_dd.style.display="none";_dd.innerHTML="";return;}'
shtml += 'var hits=_names.filter(function(n){return n.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0}).slice(0,8);'
shtml += '_dd.innerHTML="";'
shtml += 'if(hits.length===0){_dd.style.display="none";return;}'
shtml += 'hits.forEach(function(n){'
shtml += 'var d=document.createElement("div");'
shtml += 'd.textContent=n;'
shtml += 'd.style.cssText="padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0;";'
shtml += 'd.addEventListener("mouseenter",function(){d.style.background="#f0f4ff"});'
shtml += 'd.addEventListener("mouseleave",function(){d.style.background="white"});'
shtml += 'd.addEventListener("click",function(){'
shtml += '_in.value=n;_dd.style.display="none";'
shtml += 'if(_locs[n]){' + map_name + '.setView(_locs[n],9);}'
shtml += '});'
shtml += '_dd.appendChild(d);});'
shtml += '_dd.style.display="block";});'
# Close dropdown on click outside
shtml += 'document.addEventListener("click",function(e){'
shtml += 'if(!document.getElementById("srch-wrap").contains(e.target)){_dd.style.display="none";}});'
shtml += '</script>'
m.get_root().html.add_child(folium.Element(shtml))

leg = '<div style="position:fixed;bottom:30px;left:30px;z-index:1000;background:white;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;">'
leg += '<b>Range = 150km</b> <span style="color:#888;font-size:9px">(Range = 150km)</span><br>'
leg += '<span style="color:#1d4ed8">\u25cf</span> City w/ resort (' + str(len(matched)) + ')<br>'
leg += '<span style="color:#94a3b8">\u25cf</span> City, no resort (' + str(len(unmatched)) + ')<br>'
leg += '<span style="color:#dc2626">\u25b2</span> Ski resort (' + str(len(r_valid)) + ')<br>'
leg += '<hr style="margin:3px 0;border:none;border-top:1px solid #eee">'
leg += '<span style="color:#999;font-size:9px">Data: ' + ts + '</span></div>'
m.get_root().html.add_child(folium.Element(leg))

m
